requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health and hold a high-school diploma or equivalent.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants outside the standard age or under 18
requirements.ruleText: Applicants are generally 18-30 years old; an applicant under 18 must submit the published guardian documentation.
Complete the Wuhan University international-student online application and upload the required evidence.
Submit the passport identity page.
Submit the high-school diploma; a current graduating student may submit official expected-graduation proof and must provide the final diploma after admission.
Submit the complete high-school academic transcript.
WHU's 2026 liberal-arts combination requires Professional Chinese (Humanities) and Mathematics.
New HSK level 4 with a score of 180 or above; published native-Chinese or prior Chinese-medium exemptions may apply.
Submit a financial statement showing at least USD 5,000 or equivalent.

Submit by June 30, 2026; this historical application cycle is closed.
Participate in the university interview or examination when requested after document review.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 20,000 per year.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health.
Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent and normally be no older than 35.
Complete the Wuhan University international-student online application and upload the required evidence.
Submit the passport identity page and the applicable China visa or residence information if relevant.
Submit the bachelor's degree certificate; a current graduating student may submit official expected-graduation proof.
Submit the complete bachelor's academic transcript.
Submit two recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or equivalent experts.
Submit a study or research plan of at least 1,000 words.

references.locator: Application materials: study or research plan

requirements.ruleText: New HSK level 4 with a score of 180 or above; published native-Chinese or prior Chinese-medium exemptions may apply.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who previously studied in China
requirements.ruleText: Submit the academic records and status evidence required for prior study in China.

references.locator: Application materials: prior study in China

requirements.ruleText: Submit a financial statement showing at least USD 5,000 or equivalent.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of CNY 800 or USD 111.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed as required by the guide.
Submit by June 15, 2026; this historical application cycle is closed.
Participate in the university interview or examination when requested after document review.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 23,000 per year.
